training.purpose: L4 training and frozen selection evidence

observation.purpose: post-training observation within the 2021-2024 selection boundary

holdout.purpose: sealed L6 display only after selection and best-event freeze

book_imbalance.research_question: Does spread conditioning or microprice displacement stabilize order-book imbalance?
book_imbalance.single_variable_control: Change only window/depth or the named spread/microprice mechanism against the parent.
book_imbalance.hypothesis: State-conditioned depth imbalance carries more stable signed information than unconditional depth.
book_imbalance.success_condition: Training and observation agree in raw-signed direction on at least one expected event with adequate coverage and no parent contradiction.
book_imbalance.rejection_condition: Technical evidence is complete but the pre-registered mechanism is not replicated or does not improve its parent.
book_imbalance.stop_condition: Missing parent portrait, lookahead, denominator drift, or shared quote-data failure stops the family and round.

judgement_rules.supported: training and observation direction agree with stable IC/LS and coverage
judgement_rules.promising: consistent signal exists but one split, universe, label, or metric is incomplete
judgement_rules.unsupported: evaluable without replication or incremental support
judgement_rules.not_evaluable: not_ready, insufficient coverage, or undefined metric
judgement_rules.error: data, schema, finite-value, timing, or denominator error

flow_pressure.research_question: Does persistence or decay of signed trade pressure outperform a static flow window?
flow_pressure.single_variable_control: Change only half-life/persistence or window against the signed-flow parent.
flow_pressure.hypothesis: Persistent signed flow contains information beyond a static event-count aggregate.
flow_pressure.success_condition: A pre-registered persistence variant repeats signed evidence in training and observation without future trades.
flow_pressure.rejection_condition: No repeatable incremental evidence over the parent despite complete technical coverage.
flow_pressure.stop_condition: Unknown trade direction, lookahead, shared trade-stream failure, or denominator drift stops the round.

impact_efficiency.research_question: Does conditioning order flow on realized price response add information beyond signed impact?
impact_efficiency.single_variable_control: Change only response normalization/absorption or opening availability against the parent.
impact_efficiency.hypothesis: The same flow with different price response identifies impact efficiency or absorption.
impact_efficiency.success_condition: Response/absorption variant repeats signed evidence in training and observation with explicit no-response handling.
impact_efficiency.rejection_condition: No incremental evidence over the parent or response is unavailable at the event.
impact_efficiency.stop_condition: Future prices, unsupported opening semantics, shared quote/trade failure, or denominator drift stops the round.

liquidity_resilience.research_question: Does recovery measured only after an explicit liquidity shock improve resilience evidence?
liquidity_resilience.single_variable_control: Change only shock threshold, recovery window, or warmup against the parent.
liquidity_resilience.hypothesis: Conditional post-shock recovery is more interpretable than unconditional recovery speed.
liquidity_resilience.success_condition: Only explicit, backward-visible shocks produce repeated signed evidence in training and observation.
liquidity_resilience.rejection_condition: No incremental evidence over the parent or no explicit shock coverage.
liquidity_resilience.stop_condition: Future shock detection, shared quote failure, denominator drift, or missing parent portrait stops the round.

success_conditions: All four batches and 16 candidates have complete L2/L3/L4 receipts
Training and observation evidence is classified at factor × event × universe × label × split granularity
A selected holdout-display list and best event are frozen before any 2025 read
rejection_conditions: A candidate is technically evaluable but fails its preregistered replication or parent-increment rule
Evidence is not sufficient to claim support; retain the unit as unsupported or not_evaluable without promotion
stop_conditions: Any 2025 read before selection and best-event freeze
Any future-data, hash, duplicate-key, denominator, readiness, or shared-input failure
Any attempt to use holdout feedback for selection, direction, parameters, candidates, batches, or promotion

selection.best_event_policy: freeze per universe x label using training/observation only before any holdout read

forbidden_behaviors: using holdout feedback to change direction, parameters, candidates, or batches
